name: EstateSaleBiz
tagline: Run a whole estate sale business, not just list one.
description: EstateSaleBiz is a live, multi-tenant platform for running an estate sale business — pricing tools for the contents of a house, staffing and day-of checklists, and a public storefront with its own checkout, one city at a time.

name: GarageSaleBiz
tagline: The map a town checks before it gets in the car.
description: GarageSaleBiz turns a single garage sale into a business: a public map of every sale across three cities, a self-serve listing tool for sellers, and the Saturday-morning traffic that comes with being the map people actually check.

name: ConsignmentBiz
tagline: The storefront and the paperwork, in one place.
description: ConsignmentBiz runs the storefront and back office behind a consignment shop — intake, splits, and a public site where buyers browse what's currently on the floor, replacing the shared spreadsheet a shop like this normally runs on.

name: SiteLab
tagline: Thirty-two trade sites, one system behind them.
description: SiteLab is the system behind the thirty-two storefronts at /sites/ — one content file per trade, a shared template, an operator admin panel, and a marketing kit, so a new niche launches from data instead of a rebuild.

name: YourLife CC
description: YourLife CC is a faith-and-family PWA that helps parents run their household — chores, allowance, life skills, and a Christian faith path — installable and working across devices, built on Vercel, Supabase, Stripe, and Brevo.
features: Faith Journey — a guided, Duolingo-style discipleship path inside the app.
Return — a QR-code tote inventory system built for a church's men's retreat.
Legacy Vault — a private place for parents to preserve letters and memories for their children.

name: Church for Truckers
tagline: Faith on the road. Hope at every mile.
description: Church for Truckers is a ministry web presence for a trucker-focused congregation in Farmington, Missouri, built on Next.js with a Pastor Portal for managing content, migrated off WordPress.

name: Prime Bin Cleaning
tagline: Residential bin power-washing, booked from a phone.
description: Prime Bin Cleaning is the web presence and booking front for a real, teen-owned residential garbage-bin cleaning service in Idaho's Treasure Valley — pricing, process, before/after results, and a text-to-book flow.

name: Dom Vegz
description: Dom Vegz is the official artist site for EDM producer and DJ Dom Vegz — releases, shows, videos, photos, and booking, with an admin panel and YouTube sync so the artist manages his own content.

name: Kingdom Creatives
description: Kingdom Creatives provides sponsor-funded church websites, sermon tools, and communication systems to underserved churches at no cost to the church — built for churches, designed for pastors.
note: Hosting is being moved. The site is down; the company is not.
